definitions.canos_pf_mse: Mean over graphs of MSE_PQ + MSE_PV + MSE_Slack + MSE_Branch; checked against CANOS_PF_MSE per batch
definitions.PBL Mean: Mean over graphs of mean over buses of sqrt(delta_P^2 + delta_Q^2)
definitions.PBL Max: Maximum bus mismatch over the specified set (not average graph maximum)
definitions.PBL L2: Mean graph L2 norm of concatenated active and reactive bus mismatches
definitions.Relative PBL Mean: Mean graph PBL Mean divided by that graph's mean bus demand magnitude (clamped at 1e-8)
definitions.Relative PBL Mean / Max Load: Mean graph PBL Mean divided by that graph's maximum bus demand magnitude (clamped at 1e-8)
